tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every view.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables and the sidebar, one step above bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered and selected rows, inputs, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline dividers, panel edges and chart gridlines. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons, checkboxes and chart axes; muted chart series. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (labels, captions, timestamps, placeholders) on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive hue: links, the focus ring, selected text and the first gradient stop. Accent text reads on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill or on the gradient; at least 4.5:1 across the whole gradient in both themes.

tokens.name: neon-violet
tokens.usage: The second neon hue: the gradient's end stop, or a second highlighted chart series beside accent. Never text or a status.

tokens.name: gradient-start
tokens.usage: First stop of the cyan-to-violet gradient (135deg).

tokens.name: gradient-end
tokens.usage: Last stop of the cyan-to-violet gradient (135deg).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive sentiment and success, always next to a word or icon. Reads on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and partial or stale data, always next to a word or icon. Reads on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Negative sentiment, errors and destructive actions, always next to a word or icon. Reads on bg, surface and surface-raised.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page heading, once per view.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Lentitud al abrir y cargar la aplicación

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel titles and section heads; the product name in the top bar.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, topic names and table cells.
styles.sample: Elige un tema para ver sus reseñas.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Review text and the model's topic description; the representative quote uses it at 16/26px.
styles.sample: Tarda muchísimo en abrir. A veces me quedo más de un minuto viendo el logo.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, hints, chart axis labels and legends, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, filter group labels and table column headers, in ink-muted. The only uppercase text.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: KPI tile values; the mood ring centre and the detail's stat strip use it at 24px.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Counts, shares, dates, ids and codes in rows, legends and meta lines, with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip and badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding and the gap between panels; minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on wide screens; space above the page heading.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, checkboxes and chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only. Panels sit flat and are separated by line.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Neon edge around the focus ring and the selected chart data point.

tokens.name: glow-md
tokens.usage: Cyan-to-violet halo on hover of the primary button only.
